clues: This city is the capital of a state in the west of Mexico, and its largest town. It is the busy heart of trade and art for the lands near it.
Here the rain comes in one main season, and the rest of the year stays dry. In summer a great band of rain clouds moves north and dumps heavy rain, which cools the hot days.
A first town was set up here in early 1532 by a Basque man of arms. The town was moved more than once, and came to rest here in 1542.
This city is a great home of mariachi music, tequila drink, and birria stew. These are famed gifts of its land's way of life, loved all round the world.
Its famed cathedral is a top sight of this city. So is a grand old hospice, now a World Heritage Site known far and wide.
